summary: The community has approved a patch release of Parquet Java 1.18.2 that incorporates critical fixes and dependency updates, with support from key contributors. Separately, a discussion is underway to introduce a new logical type, VECTOR (or FINITE_VECTOR), to represent fixed‑length numeric vectors and enforce non‑null and finite constraints.

highlights.text: Patch release of Parquet Java 1.18.2 includes critical fixes and dependency updates, backed by community members such as Fokko and Steve.
Proposal to add a logical type VECTOR (or FINITE_VECTOR) for fixed‑length numeric vectors, ensuring non‑null and finite values.

sources.title: Re: [DISCUSS] Numeric Vector type: physical representation (outcome of focused call)
